functional.title: Life portfolio
functional.statement: The system shall hold areas, objectives and projects in one structure covering professional, personal, study and travel work, with no separate work and life modes.

functional.title: Objectives carry no target
functional.statement: An objective shall store a horizon, a type and a short why-this-is-mine, and shall not store a target, a schedule or a reserve.

functional.title: Derived objective state
functional.statement: The system shall derive an objective's state from whether a live project sits under it and when it was last touched, and shall read it as dormant after four weeks with nothing active, offering shelve or revive in neutral language.

functional.title: Progress log
functional.statement: The system shall record a timestamped entry against a project or objective carrying what happened, optional effort and an optional note.

functional.title: One entry, two goals
functional.statement: An entry shall be able to additionally credit an objective belonging to a different area, so that work done in the fixed job counts toward a learning objective.

functional.title: Steps per active project
functional.statement: Each active project shall carry a short list of next steps covering only the next stretch of work, never a decomposition of the whole project, with an optional estimate on each step.

functional.title: Weekly commitment with reserve
functional.statement: A commitment shall be expressed as a frequency or volume over a week as target plus reserve, where the reserve defaults to ceil(0.30 x target) with a minimum of 1, and shall never be expressed as a recurring clock slot. Each commitment shall carry the unit its target is counted in, times or minutes (D-030).

functional.title: Reserve spend is an event
functional.statement: Spending a reserve shall be recorded as an event and shall not be a silently decremented counter, and shall carry no penalty language.

functional.title: Inferred capacity
functional.statement: The system shall infer capacity from the log, shall never block on it, and shall accept a light, normal or heavy label applied retroactively at weekly close as the authoritative correction.

functional.title: Adaptive weekly proposal
functional.statement: The system shall derive the next week's targets from logged history rather than from a target set once, shall present them as an editable proposal, and shall retain what was proposed alongside what the owner accepted as an internal calibration signal. The proposal is the median of what was achieved in the last four closed weeks, per commitment and in that commitment's unit; with fewer than four it is the median of what exists, and with none there is no proposal and the field opens empty (D-030). The four is a starting value with no evidence behind it.

functional.title: Weekly close
functional.statement: The weekly close shall offer three fields, of which two are optional: the capacity label, what took the week, and a short written reflection. A week the owner never closes shall close itself when the next Monday arrives, with no capacity label, no tag and no reflection, and the next week shall open in the same movement (D-030).

functional.title: Week attribution
functional.statement: At close the system shall accept one optional tag naming what took the week, from tags the owner defines, and shall surface the pattern across roughly eight weeks without recording any duration.

functional.title: Active cap asked, not shipped
functional.statement: The system shall ask at first setup how many projects fit a bad week and use that as the active cap, rather than shipping a constant, and shall audit it against stale rate.

functional.title: Weekly rotation
functional.statement: What is active shall be changeable every Monday at no cost and shall be fixed within the week. A week starts Monday on the local calendar, and an entry belongs to the week holding its local date (D-030).

functional.title: Fixed-job area
functional.statement: The fixed job shall be an area whose projects have their own quota with no cap and never compete for the active cap.

functional.title: External deadlines only
functional.statement: A project shall be able to carry a hard date only when the owner did not set it; the date shall order priority and protect the project's slot, and shall never schedule hours or raise a reminder.

functional.title: Shelving
functional.statement: Shelving a project or objective shall be reversible, shall carry no penalty language, and shelved items shall stay visible in the portfolio.

functional.title: Progress before remainder
functional.statement: Every progress surface shall render accumulated progress before remaining work, and shall express consistency as a ratio over a period rather than as a consecutive-day count.

functional.title: Clean week boundary
functional.statement: A closed week shall not roll any missed work forward as debt, and the next week shall open with no carried state.

functional.title: Estimate calibration
functional.statement: The system shall capture an estimate on each step and compare it against the effort on the entries attributed to that step, attribution being fixed when each entry is written and left null when no single step of the project was marked that day, feeding the ratio back as a personal calibration signal rather than as a failure.

functional.title: Full export
functional.statement: The system shall export the owner's entire database to a downloadable SQLite file on demand, so that the owner always holds a complete copy of their own record.
functional.source: D-005 — the mitigation the privacy reversal is conditional on

functional.title: The day list
functional.statement: The system shall let the owner mark, at any point in the day, which steps they will do that day, drawn from projects active in the current week; the mark shall carry no hour, no duration and no condition, shall be subject to no daily cap beyond FR-13's weekly one, and shall expire at the end of the day leaving no record of what went unmarked or undone.

functional.title: Finishing a project
functional.statement: A project shall be markable as finished on any day, carrying the moment it was finished rather than a third state; finishing shall free its slot against the active cap at once, shall be reversible by returning the project to shelved, and shall be rendered without congratulation or any reward language.

nonFunctional.title: Logging cost
nonFunctional.statement: The median time from opening the application to a saved progress entry shall be under 20 seconds, and no flow shall make recording progress slower than planning it.

nonFunctional.title: Single user
nonFunctional.statement: The system shall serve exactly one owner and shall build no accounts, sharing, teams, permissions or comments.

nonFunctional.title: Ownership modelled explicitly
nonFunctional.statement: The data model shall model ownership explicitly even while there is one owner, so that adding a second party later is additive rather than a migration.

nonFunctional.title: Managed hosting, with an exit
nonFunctional.statement: The data lives on Turso's managed infrastructure, reached from Cloudflare Workers, rather than on infrastructure the owner controls — a deliberate reversal recorded in D-031 and D-032, taken so the product is reachable from a phone at all (NFR-1). Turso can technically read the data at rest and Cloudflare handles it in transit; the vendor serving the application is deliberately not the vendor holding the data. The owner shall never be locked in: FR-21 guarantees a full local copy, and any change of store must carry that export across with it. No third-party analytics or telemetry.

nonFunctional.title: Responsive web
nonFunctional.statement: The interface shall be a responsive web application usable one-handed in a phone browser.

nonFunctional.title: Fast first render
nonFunctional.statement: The portfolio shall render quickly on a phone browser. Offline reads are explicitly not required: narrowed from offline-tolerant reads when the interface was settled as server-rendered HTML, a loss taken deliberately rather than overlooked.

nonFunctional.title: Informational feedback only
nonFunctional.statement: Feedback shall be informational rather than evaluative or competitive, with no points, badges, levels, leaderboards, red debt states or accumulated-failure counters.

nonFunctional.title: Week attribution guardrails
nonFunctional.statement: Week attribution shall appear only in the weekly close and never on the landing surface, shall never be rendered in red or accumulated as debt across weeks, and shall never use the word lost; a week closed without a tag shall be as complete as one with it.

nonFunctional.title: No chasing notifications
nonFunctional.statement: The system shall send no push notifications, no reminder email and no you-missed-X prompt.

nonFunctional.title: Evidence-bound design
nonFunctional.statement: A behaviour that contradicts a rule in research.md shall require a decision file naming the finding it overrides and why.
